question: What will be the highest price SPDR Gold Trust (GLD) trades at on July 24, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Below $360": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is strictly below $360.00.
- "$360.00 – $364.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is at or above $360.00 and strictly below $365.00.
- "$365.00 – $369.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is at or above $365.00 and strictly below $370.00.
- "$370.00 – $374.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is at or above $370.00 and strictly below $375.00.
- "$375.00 – $379.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is at or above $375.00 and strictly below $380.00.
- "$380.00 – $384.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is at or above $380.00 and strictly below $385.00.
- "$385.00 or above": Wins if the official intraday high price of GLD on July 24, 2026 on NYSE Arca is at or above $385.00.

Clarifications:
- The intraday high is the single highest transaction price recorded for GLD during regular NYSE Arca trading hours (9:30 AM – 4:00 PM ET) on July 24, 2026; pre-market and after-hours prices are excluded.

data_sources: Macrotrends – SPDR Gold Shares Price History
